events.title: Bank of America Chicago Marathon: cheer along the course
events.venue: Chicago Marathon course; Grant Park reunion area
events.address: Grant Park, Chicago, IL 60605; see official course map
events.description: Cheer for runners along the marathon route through 29 neighborhoods. Start and finish zones are restricted; Grant Park opens to spectators at 9:30 AM. Expect road closures and use CTA where possible.
events.time: Professional start 7:30 AM; waves through 8:35 AM

events.title: Lincoln Park Wine Fest
events.description: The tenth annual neighborhood wine festival offers two-hour tasting sessions with twelve standard pours, a keepsake glass and food vendors. Tickets are specific to a day and session; valid ID is required.

events.title: Oktoberfestiversary at Begyle and Dovetail
events.address: 1800 W Cuyler Ave / 4114 N Ravenswood Ave, Chicago, IL 60613
events.priceLabel: $5 suggested donation; food and drink extra
events.description: Two neighboring breweries celebrate fall with live bands, food trucks, a beer garden and family activities. The suggested gate donation supports The Friendship Center; food and drinks cost extra.

events.title: 53rd Annual Historic Pullman House Tour
events.venue: Pullman Exhibit Hall and neighborhood homes
events.address: 11141 S Cottage Grove Ave, Chicago, IL 60628
events.priceLabel: From $21; check source for day-of pricing
events.age: Under 16 with parent or legal guardian
events.description: A once-a-year opportunity to step inside private homes in Chicago’s historic Pullman community. The self-guided route explores restored interiors and contemporary renovations in the nineteenth-century planned neighborhood.
events.sourceName: Friends of Pullman National Historical Park

events.title: Chicago Latino Dance Festival: closing afternoon
events.description: The festival’s fourth edition brings eight groups to Humboldt Park, spanning Afro-Latin, Indigenous, folkloric and contemporary dance. This free all-ages afternoon closes the festival’s series; the organizer requests an RSVP.
events.sourceName: Chicago Park District / International Latino Cultural Center
events.time: 3:00 PM; check source for end time

events.title: Night of 1,000 Jack-o’-Lanterns
events.description: Follow an illuminated outdoor trail of hand-carved pumpkins, watch live carving and meet costumed performers. The 2026 display adds a twenty-foot Monarch Skull sculpture. Event admission is separate from daytime garden admission.

events.title: Beck with Ioanna Gika and Wayne Faler
events.address: 50 E Ida B. Wells Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
events.description: Beck plays the second night of his Auditorium engagement, with Ioanna Gika and Wayne Faler on the bill. Check the venue’s ticket link for current availability before heading downtown.

events.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio with the Chicago Philharmonic
events.address: 50 E Ida B. Wells Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
events.description: A full orchestra, chorus and vocal soloists bring Shoji Meguro’s music for the award-winning role-playing game to the stage. The concert pairs the fantasy score with the Chicago Philharmonic.

events.title: Chicago Blackhawks vs. Carolina Hurricanes
events.description: The Blackhawks host Carolina for Saturday evening hockey at the United Center. Check the official ticket inventory before heading to the arena.

events.title: Tenderfest Chicago: evening session
events.venue: East End Plaza at Navy Pier
events.priceLabel: Check source for remaining evening admission
events.description: Chicago’s first Tenderfest combines unlimited chicken-tender tastings with music, entertainment and chef competitions. The evening session is already underway; confirm remaining admission and last-entry details before traveling.
events.time: Until 9:00 PM; 5 PM session already underway; check last entry

events.title: Glass Pumpkin Patch: final day
events.priceLabel: Included with Arboretum admission; check source
events.description: Browse thousands of artist-made glass pumpkins at the final day of this annual fall show. Live glassblowing runs through the afternoon, with the last demonstration starting at 4:30 PM.

events.title: Scarecrow Weekend in St. Charles
events.address: Lincoln Park, 450 W Main St, St. Charles, IL 60174
events.description: Downtown St. Charles fills with more than 120 handmade scarecrows for the festival’s forty-first year. Vote for favorites, catch live entertainment and explore the family and activity zones on the closing day.

events.title: Downtown Lake Geneva Oktoberfest
events.venue: Flat Iron Park and downtown Lake Geneva
events.description: Make a fall day trip for German music, food, a beer garden and family activities beside Geneva Lake. Sunday’s schedule includes live jazz and a pie-eating contest; allow extra time for the drive.

events.title: Play On! at Chicago Shakespeare Theater
events.description: Sheldon Epps directs a Duke Ellington-scored musical inspired by Twelfth Night. The production brings a songwriter’s ambitions and romantic complications to a jazz-filled Harlem setting; running time is about two and a half hours.

events.title: Play On! at Chicago Shakespeare Theater
events.description: Sheldon Epps directs a Duke Ellington-scored musical inspired by Twelfth Night. The production brings a songwriter’s ambitions and romantic complications to a jazz-filled Harlem setting; running time is about two and a half hours.

events.title: Jekyll & Hyde
events.venue: Broadway Playhouse at Water Tower Place
events.description: Kokandy Productions brings its Chicago revival of the gothic musical to the Broadway Playhouse. The intimate production explores the split between Dr. Jekyll and his dangerous alter ego; allow about two hours and thirty-five minutes.

events.title: Jekyll & Hyde
events.venue: Broadway Playhouse at Water Tower Place
events.description: Kokandy Productions brings its Chicago revival of the gothic musical to the Broadway Playhouse. The intimate production explores the split between Dr. Jekyll and his dangerous alter ego; allow about two hours and thirty-five minutes.

events.title: Topdog/Underdog
events.description: Glenn Davis and Namir Smallwood star as brothers Lincoln and Booth in Suzan-Lori Parks’s Pulitzer-winning drama. Kenny Leon directs this intimate story of rivalry, survival and the names the brothers inherited.

events.title: Topdog/Underdog

events.title: Operation Mincemeat: final Chicago weekend
events.description: The award-winning musical comedy turns an improbable Second World War deception into a fast-moving theatrical caper. This is the final weekend of the Chicago engagement, with the last performance Sunday afternoon.

events.title: Operation Mincemeat: final Chicago weekend
events.description: The award-winning musical comedy turns an improbable Second World War deception into a fast-moving theatrical caper. This is the final weekend of the Chicago engagement, with the last performance Sunday afternoon.

events.title: Don Giovanni: Lyric Opera opening night
events.description: Lyric opens its season with Mozart’s dark comedy, led by Enrique Mazzola and starring Christian Van Horn in Robert Falls’s production. Sung in Italian with English titles; running time is about three hours and twenty-five minutes.

events.title: Symphony Ball with Klaus Mäkelä: concert
events.description: Klaus Mäkelä conducts Stravinsky’s Petrushka and Walton’s Belshazzar’s Feast, with Thomas Hampson and the Chicago Symphony Chorus. Concert-only tickets are offered separately; registration for the gala dinner is closed.

events.title: Fall Fest at Lincoln Park Zoo
events.priceLabel: Free admission; rides and purchases extra
events.description: The zoo’s fall festival brings pumpkin carving, autumn gardens, seasonal treats and special animal enrichment. Sunday’s schedule includes meerkat enrichment at 3 PM; admission is free, with rides and purchases extra.

events.title: Boo! at the Zoo
events.priceLabel: Included with zoo admission; check source
events.description: A family Halloween day with trick-or-treating, festive decorations and seasonal activities throughout the zoo. Sgt. Sauerkraut’s Polka Band performs at The Grove from noon to 4 PM this Sunday.

events.title: The Attic: closing weekend
events.description: Montreal’s The 7 Fingers transforms Shana Carroll’s memories into aerial theater and acrobatic storytelling. The extended world-premiere run closes Sunday; the show lasts about two hours and ten minutes including an intermission.

events.title: The Attic: closing weekend
events.description: Montreal’s The 7 Fingers transforms Shana Carroll’s memories into aerial theater and acrobatic storytelling. The extended world-premiere run closes Sunday; the show lasts about two hours and ten minutes including an intermission.

events.title: BUTTTOOTKING: Lydia B Kollins, Suzie Toot and Kori King
events.description: Three performers from RuPaul’s Drag Race bring an all-new 2026 drag show to Metro. Costumes are encouraged, and the touring production includes a costume contest; VIP meet-and-greet tickets are separate.

events.title: Jordan Jensen at The Vic
events.description: Stand-up comedian Jordan Jensen brings her touring set to Lakeview’s Vic Theatre. Sunday’s performance is the available alternative to the venue’s sold-out Saturday show.

events.title: Failure with quannnic
events.description: Alternative-rock trio Failure brings its Rising Skyline 2026 tour to Park West with quannnic. The band’s current live chapter follows its seventh album, Location Lost.

events.title: Kanan Gill: Not This Again
events.description: Indian stand-up comedian Kanan Gill brings his Not This Again touring show to Park West. The all-ages Sunday performance opens its doors at 6 PM, an hour before the show.

events.title: Harvesting Hope at the Chicago Sukkah Design Festival
events.description: An interfaith afternoon pairs a conversation about environmental care and food security with hands-on neighborhood gardening. After the opening discussion, join tree planting, garden cleanup or a seed-and-bulb exchange.

events.title: CWILLI Fall ’26 Runway and Sample Sale
events.description: Chicago label CWILLI presents Academy, a fifteen-look black-and-white collection, followed by a sample sale. The Chicago Fashion Week event supports Howard Brown Health, with open seating assigned first come, first served.
events.time: Doors 7:15 PM; runway 8:15 PM; sale 8:30–9:30 PM

events.title: Magni-tude Evolve runway show
events.description: Shoot Media Group’s Chicago Fashion Week runway event combines fashion, art and storytelling. The 2026 show honors a late model and centers community, compassion and mental-health awareness.

events.title: Chicago Wolves home opener vs. Manitoba Moose
events.description: The Wolves begin their 2026–27 home schedule against the Manitoba Moose. Arrive early for the limited coffee-mug giveaway; this is also the season’s first Adopt-A-Dog Night.

events.title: Northern Lights with Chicago a cappella
events.description: Chicago a cappella opens its Northern Lights series with choral music from Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. John William Trotter leads the program, which lasts about 110 minutes including an intermission.

events.title: CSO Chamber Music at the University of Chicago
events.description: Six Chicago Symphony Orchestra musicians explore the connections between food and music through Beethoven, Martinů, Schoenfield and Brahms. The afternoon includes an optional pre-concert lecture and an artist discussion afterward.

events.title: Armand Hammer with Quelle Chris and Open Mike Eagle
events.description: The rap duo of billy woods and ELUCID headlines Thalia Hall, with Quelle Chris and Open Mike Eagle rounding out the bill. Expect a full evening of adventurous hip-hop in Pilsen.

events.title: EMEI: Night at the Opera Tour with googly eyes
events.description: Pop artist EMEI brings the Night at the Opera tour to Thalia Hall with support from googly eyes. Check the ticket source for current inventory and the show’s age policy.

events.title: Interpol with DIIV
events.description: Interpol’s North America Tour 2026 stops at the Salt Shed with DIIV. The venue lists this as an outdoor Fairgrounds concert, so plan for an autumn evening outside and check the latest ticket details.

events.title: Rhinofest: An Interview, Year 10
events.priceLabel: Pay what you can; check ticket source
events.description: Ira S. Murfin’s ten-year performance project connects spontaneous conversations across time. Two participants revisit the prior interview transcript and then conduct a new, unrehearsed exchange in front of the audience.

events.title: Rhinofest: Thanks for Nothing
events.priceLabel: Pay what you can; check ticket source
events.description: A zombie-filled musical with a live band turns a disastrous Thanksgiving dinner into a theatrical horror comedy. Hillary Stone and Mason Johnson’s new work debuts during this year’s Rhinoceros Theater Festival.

events.title: Chicago Textile Fair: Skill Share Showcase
events.description: The final afternoon of the Chicago Textile Fair features hands-on learning and artist-led demonstrations. This year’s Sustainable Communities theme connects fiber skills, local makers and shared creative practice.

events.title: Picturing the Modern Metropolis at The Block
events.description: This temporary exhibition gathers more than one hundred prints, photographs and drawings about the modern American city. Works by Vivian Maier, Ed Ruscha and other artists explore skylines, street life and urban change.

events.title: Fall Fest at Jefferson Memorial Park
events.description: Jefferson Park’s annual neighborhood fall celebration includes arts and crafts, pumpkins and a Halloween costume swap. The Chicago Park District and park advisory council welcome all ages to this free event.

events.title: Barrington Hills Fall Festival
events.venue: Barrington Hills Park District Riding Center
events.description: A one-day village celebration pairs live music with pony rides, crafts and equestrian history. Sunday highlights include a traveling zoo, a K9 demonstration and a giant-bubble show; the organizer recommends leaving pets at home.

events.title: Fall Festival at Danada
events.venue: Danada Equestrian Center and Danada House
events.description: Spend the day with equestrian demonstrations, trick riding, live family entertainment and historic-house tours. Sunday’s program includes the Midwest Renegades and Chicago Vaulting; admission is free, while wagon and pony rides cost extra.
events.sourceName: Forest Preserve District of DuPage County / Danada House
